claims.text: Pancreatic enzyme replacement treats steatorrhea: 75,000-150,000 USP units (25,000-50,000 international units) of lipase per meal.
claims.quote: Pancreatic enzyme replacement therapy (replacement of deficient hormones to treat pancreatic insufficiency) is used to treat steatorrhea (10). Various preparations are available, and a dose of 75,000 to 150,000 United States Pharmacopeia units (25,000 to 50,000 international units) lipase per meal

claims.text: Fat malabsorption also causes deficits of fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K).
claims.quote: Fat malabsorption also results in a deficit of fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, and K).
